bio.text: Trina Swanson, of Hermantown, is the Democratic candidate for Minnesota's 8th Congressional District in 2026; her KAXE candidate survey response lists her as a founding partner of the law firm JET Global Solutions.
In her KAXE candidate survey response, Swanson said she grew up in Hermantown and had a career at U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services before starting her own law firm.
